title: [Wuyou Decoction alleviates hippocampal neuronal injury and improves synaptic plasticity in rats with chronic sleep deprivation by inhibiting ferroptosis via activating the Nrf2/HO-1 pathway].
authors: He, Liling; Wu, Dan; Lai, Bixuan; Niu, Qixuan; Chen, Junhua; Gao, Jianhong; Long, Qinghua; Wang, Zhengyu
journal: Nan fang yi ke da xue xue bao = Journal of Southern Medical University
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药乌郁汤通过Nrf2/HO-1通路抑制铁死亡改善睡眠剥夺大鼠海马损伤，核心为动物实验与信号通路，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，仅分子对接为辅助且非针对TF-DNA，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: To investigate the mechanism of Wuyou Decoction (WYD) for ameliorating hippocampal neuron damage and protecting synaptic plasticity in rats with chronic sleep deprivation (CSD). METHODS: Fifty SD rats were randomly divided into normal control group, CSD model group, and low-, medium-, and high-dose WYD treatment groups (n=10). Except for those in the control group, all the rats were subjected to CSD modeling using the horizontal platform method. Cognitive function of the rats was assessed with Morris water mazetest, and hippocampal pathology, synaptic structure, iron content, oxidative stress markers, and ferroptosis-related protein expressions were evaluated. Molecular docking study was performed to explore the interactions between WYD components and ferroptosis-related proteins. RESULTS: CSD induced significant cognitive impairment and neuronal and synaptic damage in the rat models, causing also increased oxidative stress and iron deposition and upregulated Nrf2 and HO-1 expressions. Treatment with WYD, especially at the medium dose, significantly improved learning and memory abilities of the rat models, alleviated neuronal degeneration, restored synaptic structure, reduced iron accumulation and oxidative stress, and upregulated ferroptosis-related markers as well as Nrf2 and HO-1 expressions. CONCLUSIONS: WYD, optimally at the medium dose, alleviates CSD-induced cognitive impairment in rats by inhibiting ferroptosis, reducing neuronal damage, and enhancing synaptic repair via activation of the Nrf2/HO-1 signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 目的：探讨乌郁汤（WYD）改善慢性睡眠剥夺（CSD）大鼠海马神经元损伤及保护突触可塑性的机制。方法：将50只SD大鼠随机分为正常对照组、CSD模型组及低、中、高剂量WYD治疗组（每组10只）。除对照组外，所有大鼠采用水平台法进行CSD建模。通过Morris水迷宫实验评估大鼠认知功能，并检测海马病理、突触结构、铁含量、氧化应激标志物及铁死亡相关蛋白表达。采用分子对接研究探讨WYD成分与铁死亡相关蛋白的相互作用。结果：CSD诱导大鼠模型出现显著认知障碍及神经元和突触损伤，同时导致氧化应激增加、铁沉积增多，并上调Nrf2和HO-1表达。WYD治疗，尤其是中剂量，显著改善模型大鼠的学习记忆能力，减轻神经元变性，恢复突触结构，减少铁积累和氧化应激，并上调铁死亡相关标志物及Nrf2和HO-1表达。结论：WYD，最佳剂量为中剂量，通过激活Nrf2/HO-1信号通路抑制铁死亡、减少神经元损伤并增强突触修复，从而缓解CSD诱导的大鼠认知障碍。
